blurb:
1 EPIC TOUR:

Received the Honolulu 2025 Best Tour Agency Award. 
We have received the 2023 & 2024 Trip Advisor Travelers Choice Award as "Best of The Best" and Trip Advisors Top 10% in the World for Tour Bookings.

We are proud and excited to give you the best of Oahu. We provide a Transit Van or Shuttle to drive our guests around the island on a Circle Island Tour with a professional CDL Licensed Driver/Guide.

Visit top locations like Halona Blowhole, Kualoa Ranch, Macadamia Nut Farm, Waimea Botanical Garden and the Dole Plantation.

A very "Detailed Text" will be sent out the day before the Tour. 
If you "Do Not" get a Text on the day before your Tour, We did not get the Reservation or your Contact Number. 

We will Pick up every Booked Guest Directly from every Hotel within the Waikiki area. 
Please call for Bigger Groups. 
We can accomodate any size Group.
